# Retained verification fixtures

`pro-rata-v2-entitlement-local-revised-hist.v3.verification-report.json` is a
frozen local-Anvil verification report retained to test backward compatibility
of the v3 report verifier. It was generated for manifest
`0x9e41374c74e541b8d2a32536ad1f2f0768aa8116659096a9f810516ec74d171c` and its
report root is
`5fdc9108e06fcd56aaf9a74eff5a071d93ffa9f7d5b4368026dcbd61bc06bc6b`.

This fixture is verification evidence only. It is not a deployment approval,
public-chain observation, or production qualification. The corresponding
working deployment records under `deployments/` remain ignored local artifacts.
